about: Every constraint and applied force a take's physics may use, declared (plan 5.1, shortcuts are declared; docs/moonshot/physics.md, Declared shortcuts). moonshot/validate/shortcuts.py fails a take that uses anything not listed here by name or fnmatch pattern. `shortcuts` are non-physical assists, each standing in for something the scene can't model, reported with how long it was on; `grip_assist` ones count toward the deformable-pad trigger (plan 3.1). `mechanisms` are the model's own structure: the body's couplings, the vise's screw ratio and its AngLock; a force is named "force on <body>". Protected (plan 6, rule 1): declaring a shortcut is moving the bar.

enclose.stands_in_for: Flesh conforming round the crank's knob, which capsule fingers can't

screw_lock.stands_in_for: The lead screw self-locking under clamp load

keep_para_*.stands_in_for: Parallels resting under their own friction until checked

keep_stop.stands_in_for: The stop held where it was set, as a vise stop's clamp holds it, for the part to be set against

clamped.stands_in_for: The vise's clamp on the part in the steps after it is tightened (Find X and Y, Set Z), where nothing pushes on the part; the Seat step's take proves the clamp itself

dial_pinch.stands_in_for: Fingertips' grip on the jog handle's knurled rim while a stroke turns it, which capsule fingers on a smooth cylinder can't hold without slipping

carry_*.stands_in_for: Fingers' hold on what a hand carries, which capsule fingers can't keep steady: the object welded to the hand for the carry. A hand tool carried and used at the inspection bench (the deburr blade, the caliper; your decision 2026-11-03), and a part or tool a step take carries (the parallels, the stop, the air gun: moonshot/sim/runner.py eq_name; your decision 2026-11-04). On a pick off a plate's bracket, carry_holder also regrips in the air (moonshot/sim/tool_load.py regrip; your decision 2026-11-05): over the window from the slide-out's end to the lift's end, the holder free in the air, the holder's pose in the hand eases (min-jerk) toward the planned grip, correcting up to what the hand closed off (13-20 deg on the back row) and stopping within REGRIP_KEEP_DEG = 6 deg of the grip, as a hand settles onto what it holds once it is free

dial_lock.stands_in_for: The jog handle's detent holding it where the hand left it: outside a stroke's grip the handle is locked at its detent, as a hand placing itself on the rim, regripping it and coming off it doesn't turn it, where capsule fingers lagging their plan by centimetres brush it round; and the click that brings the machine to a jog's number locks it, as the hand stops on the number

mechanisms.lead_screw: The vise's lead screw as an exact ratio (moonshot/world/vise.py)
mechanisms.saw_vise_screw: The band saw's vise screw as an exact ratio of its handwheel, as the Kurt vise's lead_screw (moonshot/world/bandsaw.py; declared a mechanism, your decision 2026-11-04)
mechanisms.clamp_thread_*: A step clamp's flange nut on its 1/2-13 stud: the nut's run along the stud as an exact ratio of its turn, the thread's 1.954 mm lead, the same form as lead_screw and saw_vise_screw (moonshot/world/spoilboard.py threads; declared a mechanism, your decision 2026-11-05). The nut is spun down by fingertip contact and snugged with a wrench (carry_wrench). The thread doesn't carry a clamp's 5 kN bite (MuJoCo's soft equality gives under it at the thread's 3,200:1): while the plate is cut the clamped weld does
mechanisms.force on moving_jaw: Kurt's AngLock: the moving jaw's angled nut pushes it down as it clamps, modelled as a downward force of 5% of the clamp force on the jaw (moonshot/sim/vise_take.py ANGLOCK; declared a mechanism, your decision 2026-11-03)
mechanisms.eq_st25_*: The ST-25's chuck on its drawtube: the BR10's three jaws, or the 5C collet's three fingers, move as one (eq_st25_jaw_*, eq_st25_collet_*: exact 1:1 ratios, as the wedge or the collet's one piece moves them), the cylinder's draw applied at each through the wedge's or the taper's ratio with the maker's friction, and the drawtube and piston's 5.8 kg carried by the jaws as their reflected inertia (m / 3r^2), the oil's flow as their damping; the hidden drawtube, touching nothing in the headstock, shown following them by the exact ratio rather than simulated: tied to them, its 4-6x lever left their stops and contacts too soft to hold 10-20 kN (moonshot/world/st25.py workholding_xml; declared a mechanism, your decision, 2026-11-06)
mechanisms.st25_pedal: The ST-25's chuck foot pedal pressed by the operator's foot, which the body model hasn't (it has no legs): the press is an input to the control, timed by the plan (moonshot/world/st25.py Control.press_pedal); the pedal's own spring and switch, the chuck and its grip are simulated (declared a mechanism, your decision, 2026-11-06)
